problem: The /en/prijzen route had lang=en and correct routing but still rendered the Dutch pricing H1 because one or more unrelated static-English cache misses disabled translation for the entire site build.
root_cause: build-localized-routes.mjs returned null for the complete translation map whenever STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and any public string was absent from cache. That all-or-nothing fallback caused every English route to be emitted from Dutch source even when the route's own important strings were already cached.
prevention: Offline static-English generation must preserve every cached translation instead of disabling the whole translation map.
Missing translations are isolated to their own text nodes and routes; they must not downgrade unrelated English routes.
Each English route records truthful data-bg-static-translated=false while any string on that route remains untranslated.
The pricing H1 cache fragments Prices for, digitalization and in SMEs are regression-locked.
Terminal release still requires exact-main production identity plus real-browser NL-to-EN-to-NL proof on homepage, pricing and systems/koppelingen.
